declaration.note: Written before any competition prediction statistic was computed. No model/decoder change; no competition ground truth read; no public-window statistic.
declaration.truth_band: Match-level possessions per active minute of provider labels over the 18 external TRAIN+eval matches with H/A/D labels (3 sportec, 2+1 metrica, 8+3 skillcorner_had); band = [min, max]. Spent Sportec confirmation matches (J03WPY/J03WQQ/J03WR9) reported only as a sensitivity band. Active = period>0 and label != X.
declaration.holdout_stats: Adopted combined ensemble (seeds 2026/2027 averaged 50/50, Viterbi cost 3) on the 5 eval matches, clean and feed_like (corrupt_1/corrupt_2 averaged within match). Active frames = reference graded frames (label != X, period>0). Ratios = predicted/true on the same match.
declaration.competition_active: period>0 frames of data/challenge/inputs.npz (both halves); ball visible = finite ball coordinates. Whole match only.

flags.FRAGMENTING: competition poss_per_min > band max OR competition frac_lt3s > max over the 5 holdout matches of feed_like frac_lt3s (replicate-mean)
flags.applied_to: each package (adopted, previous) separately; MERGING and FRAGMENTING are not mutually exclusive in output but checked in that order
flags.gap_driven_switching: competition poss_ratio_missing_over_visible > 1.5 AND mean over 5 holdout matches of feed_like (replicate-mean) poss_ratio_missing_over_visible <= 1.5

closest_condition.method: reference = mean over the 5 matches of each condition (clean, feed_like) of replicate-averaged stat vector; scale = per-stat population std over the 10 match-by-condition vectors; distance = RMS of z-differences; closer one wins

declaration.switch_cost_table: Descriptive only: saved feed_like holdout probabilities decoded at costs 2,3,4,6,8; holdout spellF1 reported per cost (mean within match over replicates, within provider, then equal provider mean). Competition per-cost possessions/min only if label-free probabilities can be produced without changing the model; no adoption recommendation beyond "worth a declared study" / "not worth it".
declaration.caveat: Provider labels are event/provider-derived silver labels; definitions differ somewhat from the competition ground truth, so the band is an approximate prior, not the competition truth.
